rubric: group is social. The Instagram page s1 is recorded with result blocked (a login wall), not read, and no finding cites it. A social_presence finding rests on the search snippet s2 and is assumed, never found. The Facebook profile, which no source here shows, is not described as read or active: it is either absent from the findings or noted as not checked. Nothing is invented beyond what the snippet says.
